description: Granular pitch shifter, cutting the input into grains and laying them down again at a different spacing

params.text: Sets the shift, from half speed for an octave down, through the middle for no change, to double for an octave up
Sets the length of each grain, 20 to 5000 samples
Sets how often a grain is taken from the input, every 10 to 10000 samples
Sets how often a grain is laid back down, every 10 to 10000 samples; against the analysis setting this is what stretches or squeezes the sound
Picks the shape faded over each grain, stepping through Welch, Tukey, Hann, Blackman, Blackman-Nuttall and Blackman-Harris
Sets how steep the fade in and out of each grain is, on the Tukey and Blackman shapes that take it

inputs.text: The signal being cut into grains
0V to 10V adds to the shift, taking it as far as double at the top
0V to 10V adds 100 to 5000 samples to the grain length
0V to 10V adds up to 10000 samples to the analysis spacing
0V to 10V adds up to 10000 samples to the synthesis spacing
